display_name: LoRa W24 固定扣噪幅度的方向训练对照
description: One F-free supervised source fit for an eight-chirp direction head that preserves the original center/edges correction L2 norms exactly. Independent E104 source screening only.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA performance research goal.

code.environment: N607 existing PyTorch environment, GPU fit and CPU source smoke, prediction and independent scorer.
code.cwd: Owned release for TX/F-free fit, exact W24 archive for source validation after freeze.

data.representation: Continuous 8192 complex samples at 1 MHz through DURA; untouched W24 front end receives the resulting packet.
data.physical_ids_ref: Exactly the r01 Practical U pair bank and original r02 carve (20,000 fit, 500 held). Same registered V panel of 300 distinct physical packets for each Full view.
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.validation_ref: Reuse VALIDATED_ONCE lora_full_packets_v1 registered V order and true E104.
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Fit U_s only with source simulator paired waveform targets. E104 can be opened only after terminal source freeze, evaluation process only. No target.

checkpoint.initialization: Direction head random 2026112991. Existing exact-additive parent weights are frozen throughout.

sources.role: Fixed source-only Practical exact-additive 24000 update checkpoint for both readouts.
Independent source evaluation after direction checkpoint freeze.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Registered source pairing, strictly bound frozen exact parent and W24 aperture parity.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen parent of the same LoRa source contract; original source-only checkpoint
checkpoint.selection_rule: Last of 24000 steps, then fixed source V score. Promote eligibility only if six at least +18 vs frozen half, low urban at least +6, clean >= raw and receiver-stratified six-scene 95% lower net >0. Any formal launch after source qualification is registered separately.

execution.gpu_policy: One GPU trainer on the first eligible card among 0,7,2,3,6,5,1,4. Other owners and unknowns count toward cap 2. >=12 GiB free. The owned worker waits without restarting other jobs. CPU smoke and frozen source evaluation use at most two Torch and two replay workers.
execution.stop_rule: Systemic source/checkpoint/protocol/numerical failure or missing closed predictions. Preserve output. Accuracy decline does not stop the fixed training or source scoring.

metric_names: fixed magnitude direct and frozen controls
source V accuracy and paired net correction by scene
source U held directions and weak-spectrum loss
train cost and peak allocated GPU

rows.method: One full-packet phase and IQ direction head with separate hard pre-RMS center and edge norms
rows.seed_notes: New source fit seed 2026112991; registered V panel and Full draw; independent E104 seed 2026092702.
rows.optimizer: AdamW, cosine 2e-4 to 2e-5, weight decay 1e-4, clip 1.
rows.budget_ref: 24,000 source-only updates. Batch 16, including two original clean identity records. AdamW 2e-4→2e-5; gradient cap 1.

notes: 36,442 new trainable parameters, existing 111,698-parameter parent frozen; no target-specific thresholds or settings.

Direction loss uses complex alignment on native, center and edges, plus a center weak-spectrum and clean directional identity term. Equal dose before standard W24 RMS; each output normalizes its own center. The native proposed waveform is an auxiliary diagnostic, while the formal readout candidate is the constrained W24 aperture.
Frozen only when final finite update completes. The independent source scorer at most qualifies a new formal Full release; it does not access target data.
